info.title: EdgeFetch Hub API
info.summary: Self-hosted web scraping, search, browser automation, and MCP coordinator for AI agents.
info.description: EdgeFetch Hub coordinates polite outbound-only Go worker nodes (HTTP/2, Headless Chromium, Poppler PDF/OCR, and 49+ keyless site adapters) with strict RFC 9309 robots.txt and Content-Signal compliance, D1 FTS5 hybrid search, R2 content-addressed artifacts, self-hosted OAuth 2.1 PKCE, and Streamable HTTP Model Context Protocol (`POST /mcp`).

servers.description: EdgeFetch Canonical Specification Origin (replace with your self-hosted Hub URL)

tags.name: Discovery
tags.description: Health checks, OpenAPI 3.1.0 schema, RFC 9421 Web Bot Auth directory, and OAuth 2.1 metadata.

tags.name: System
tags.description: Hub capabilities, keyless site adapters, per-host health telemetry, stored artifacts, and worker fleet.

tags.name: Scraping & Extraction
tags.description: Polite URL-to-Markdown scraping, multi-URL batch scraping, BM25 passage extraction, and tab clipping.

tags.name: Browser Automation
tags.description: Sandboxed Headless Chromium interaction with dial-time SSRF isolation and session persistence.

tags.name: Crawl & Map
tags.description: Fast sitemap/llms.txt URL discovery and asynchronous breadth-first site crawling.

tags.name: Search & Collections
tags.description: Edge-first web search waterfall (Serper/Tavily/Brave/SearXNG) and private D1 FTS5 collection search.

tags.name: Vertical Intelligence
tags.description: Normalized multi-ATS job search/verification and polite full-store Shopify/WooCommerce catalog diffing.

tags.name: Autonomous Agent
tags.description: Multi-step web research and structured JSON extraction powered by BYO-LLM or local Ollama.

tags.name: Coordinator & MCP
tags.description: Low-level multi-URL coordinator dispatch (`POST /fetch`) and Streamable HTTP MCP (`POST /mcp`).

tags.name: Compatibility
tags.description: Drop-in Firecrawl v2 (`/v2/*`) compatibility endpoints for unmodified third-party SDKs.

get.summary: Check Hub liveness
get.description: Returns HTTP 200 `{ "ok": true }` without authentication for uptime monitors and container health checks.

get.summary: Fetch OpenAPI 3.1.0 specification
get.description: Returns this OpenAPI 3.1.0 document with permissive CORS (`Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`) for 1-click import into ChatGPT Actions, OpenWebUI, Dify, n8n, Postman, and Scalar.

get.summary: Get machine-readable bot transparency manifest
get.description: Declares EdgeFetch User-Agent, strict RFC 9309 robots.txt and Content-Signal (`ai-input`) policies, anti-bot challenge halt guarantee, and RFC 9421 Web Bot Auth key directory link.

get.summary: Get RFC 9421 Web Bot Auth Ed25519 JWKS directory
get.description: Serves public Ed25519 signing keys (`application/http-message-signatures-directory+json`) with cryptographic self-signatures for origin verification.

200.description: RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signatures JWKS directory.

get.summary: Get RFC 9728 OAuth 2.1 Protected Resource metadata
get.description: Advertises protected MCP resource URI, authorization server issuer, and supported scopes (`crawl:read`, `crawl:fetch`, `mcp:call`).

get.summary: Get RFC 8414 OAuth 2.1 Authorization Server metadata
get.description: Advertises `/oauth/authorize`, `/oauth/token`, `/oauth/register` (RFC 7591 Dynamic Client Registration), `/oauth/revoke`, and mandatory `S256` PKCE support (with optional multi-user Sign in with GitHub).

get.summary: Start Sign in with GitHub OAuth 2.0 + PKCE S256 login
get.description: Initiates an `oauth4webapi` OAuth 2.0 + PKCE (`S256`) + sealed `state` cookie redirect to GitHub (`https://github.com/login/oauth/authorize`) for `/admin` and `/oauth/authorize` multi-user authentication.

parameters.name: return_to
parameters.description: Optional relative Hub path (`/admin` or `/oauth/authorize?...`) to return to after sign-in.

302.description: Redirect to GitHub OAuth 2.0 authorization endpoint.

503.description: GitHub OAuth (`GITHUB_CLIENT_ID` / `GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET`) is not configured on this Hub.

get.summary: Complete Sign in with GitHub OAuth 2.0 callback
get.description: Validates OAuth `state` + PKCE `S256`, verifies `SIGNUP_MODE` (`invite_only` default) + `GITHUB_ALLOWED_USERS` (`login` or `@org`) + `GITHUB_OWNER_LOGIN`, and issues an `HS256` `jose` session JWT cookie.

302.description: Authenticated session cookie issued; redirecting back to Hub UI.

400.description: Missing/invalid state cookie or OAuth callback error.

403.description: GitHub account is not authorized under `SIGNUP_MODE` / `GITHUB_ALLOWED_USERS`.

bearerAuth.description: Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <token>` using your Hub `CALLER_TOKEN`, scoped `MCP_TOKEN`, or an OAuth 2.1 access token (`X-API-Key` is also accepted).

oauth2Pkce.description: Self-hosted OAuth 2.1 Authorization Code flow with mandatory `S256` PKCE (`code_challenge_method=S256`) and RFC 7591 Dynamic Client Registration (`POST /oauth/register`).

scopes.crawl:read: Read capabilities, keyless site adapters, host health, connected worker status, stored R2 artifacts, and search indexes.
scopes.crawl:fetch: Execute polite outbound scrapes, crawls, URL maps, browser interactions, job/catalog extractions, and autonomous agent runs.
scopes.mcp:call: Invoke tools (`action: "call_tool"`) on user-connected federated MCP servers via `POST /v1/mcp/query` or MCP `query_mcp`.

prompt.description: Optional extraction instruction when type="json" (requires an LLM provider).

schema.description: Optional JSON Schema object when type="json". Without an LLM configured, schema extraction is structural/heuristic (matching JSON-LD, headings, definition lists, and key-value lines, setting unmatched fields to null); use the agent tool for semantic LLM extraction.

formats.description: Desired output formats (e.g. ["markdown", "links"] or [{ type: "json", schema }]). Note: keyless { type: "json", schema } extraction is structural/heuristic; prefer agent for semantic extraction.

renderMode.description: "auto" (default) fetches static HTML first and only launches a headless browser on thin JavaScript-driven pages; "off" never uses a browser; "always" or "browser" forces headless browser rendering.

waitForMs.description: Extra JavaScript settle wait in milliseconds when rendering in a browser.

waitSelector.description: Optional CSS selector to wait for when rendering in a browser.

ocr.description: PDF OCR mode: "auto" runs OCR only on scanned/image-only PDFs; "always" forces OCR; "off" disables OCR.

onlyMainContent.description: Strip navigation, footer, and sidebar chrome to keep primary article content.

McpTool_ListAgentsInput.title: List Connected Crawler Agents (MCP list_agents)
McpTool_ListAgentsInput.description: Returns connected crawler worker nodes, their capabilities (HTTP vs headless browser and PDF support), CPU architectures, job counts, and active host routing pins.

McpTool_FetchUrlInput.title: Low-Level Raw HTTP Fetch (APIs/XML/Headers — Use scrape for Web Pages) (MCP fetch_url)
McpTool_FetchUrlInput.description: Fetches a single public HTTPS URL and returns raw, unparsed HTTP body bytes, status code, safe response headers, and timing. Use this ONLY for JSON/XML APIs, raw data files, or HTTP header inspection — NEVER for HTML web pages or articles (use scrape for 1 page or extract for multiple pages instead).

kind.description: Optional response kind ("json" for JSON APIs, "text" for XML/RSS/Markdown/plain text, "feed" for product JSON feeds, "page" for raw HTML). Omit to auto-detect from URL.

accept.description: Optional Accept header media type override (defaults automatically based on the URL when omitted).

target.description: Execution route ("auto" uses connected crawler nodes first with automatic overflow, "agent" forces a connected node, "container" forces cloud overflow).

site.description: Optional worker site ID to pin when target="agent".

respectRobots.description: Respect /robots.txt Allow, Disallow, and Crawl-delay rules.

includeBody.description: Include the response body preview in tool output.

maxBytes.description: Maximum inline preview size in characters/bytes (256..16777216). Larger bodies return an artifactId readable via read_artifact.

ifNoneMatch.description: Optional ETag for conditional 304 Not Modified checks.

ifModifiedSince.description: Optional Last-Modified timestamp for conditional 304 checks.

McpTool_FetchBatchInput.title: Batch Fetch Public HTTPS URLs (MCP fetch_batch)
McpTool_FetchBatchInput.description: Fetches 1 to 25 public HTTPS URLs in one polite batch and returns per-URL HTTP status, outcome ("ok", "not_found" for 404, "gone" for 410, "dns_not_found", "blocked", or "rate_limited"), headers, and optional raw body previews. Use this for batch API/feed/status checks; prefer extract when you want clean readable passages from web pages.

urls.description: 1 to 25 public https:// URLs to fetch.

kind.description: Optional kind applied to every URL; omit to auto-detect per URL.

accept.description: Optional Accept media type for text requests; omit to infer per URL.

site.description: Optional worker site ID when target="agent".

pauseJitterMs.description: Random positive jitter in milliseconds added to pauseMs.

includeBody.description: Set true to include truncated raw body previews per URL.

previewBytes.description: Maximum inline body preview characters per URL when includeBody=true (default 3072; full body can be paged via read_artifact).

McpTool_ScrapeInput.title: Scrape URL to Markdown & Metadata (MCP scrape)
McpTool_ScrapeInput.description: Reads a single public HTTPS web page, PDF, RSS/Atom feed, OpenAPI spec, or Jupyter notebook and returns clean main-content Markdown plus structured metadata (title, wordCount, favicon, canonicalUrl, contentType, links, and images). Prefer scrape for reading 1 URL, extract for query-focused passages across multiple URLs, and interact when clicking or typing in a browser is required.

waitForMs.description: Extra JavaScript settle wait in milliseconds when rendering in a browser.

waitSelector.description: Optional CSS selector to wait for when rendering in a browser.

ocr.description: PDF OCR mode: "auto" runs OCR only on scanned/image-only PDFs; "always" forces OCR; "off" disables OCR.

McpTool_ExtractInput.title: Extract Focused Passages from URLs (MCP extract)
McpTool_ExtractInput.description: Extracts clean, query-ranked Markdown passages across 1 to 20 public HTTPS URLs in one batch. Returns top matching chunks per URL (or noRelevantMatch: true with empty chunks when zero query terms appear on a page). Prefer extract for multi-URL question answering and scrape for reading one full page.

urls.description: 1 to 20 public https:// URLs to extract passages from.

query.description: Keyword or question used to rank the most relevant passages per URL (heuristic BM25 keyword ranking; returns noRelevantMatch: true when zero query terms match).

jsonFilter.description: Optional filter for JSON array responses (e.g. `title~"Engineer"` or `id=abc123`), emitting one chunk per matching record.

renderMode.description: "auto" (default) renders thin JavaScript-driven pages in a headless browser; "off" disables browser rendering; "always" forces it.

chunksPerSource.description: Maximum ranked chunks returned per URL.

includeRawContent.description: Set true to also include combined Markdown in rawContent on each result (omitted by default to avoid duplicating chunk text).

maxAgeMs.description: Reuse cached Markdown if fetched within maxAgeMs milliseconds.

redactPii.description: Redact email addresses, phone numbers, and US SSNs.

collectionId.description: Optional collection ID to index extracted pages into for search_collection.

visibility.description: Cache and index isolation mode ("private" isolates data to the authenticated user).

waybackFallback.description: Opt-in Internet Archive Wayback Machine fallback strictly on 5xx errors or unreachable hosts (never used on robots.txt blocks, 401/403/429, or bot challenges).

spaFallback.description: Optional external SPA renderer fallback when configured on the server (never used on robots.txt blocks, 403/429, or bot challenges).

site.description: Optional worker site ID when target="agent".

McpTool_MapInput.title: Map Site URLs (MCP map)
McpTool_MapInput.description: Discovers public URLs on a website using sitemaps, /llms.txt, and homepage links, returning a filtered list of links without scraping every page.

url.description: Root public https:// URL of the site to map.

search.description: Optional keyword filter to rank and narrow discovered URLs.

includeOutsidePath.description: When false (default), restricts discovered URLs to the root URL path prefix when url includes a subpath.

site.description: Optional worker site ID when target="agent".

McpTool_CrawlInput.title: Site Crawl (Run / Poll Status / Cancel) (MCP crawl)
McpTool_CrawlInput.description: Crawls multiple pages of a website breadth-first (respecting robots.txt and path filters) and indexes them into a searchable collection. Small crawls (limit <= 5) wait up to 25 seconds to return completed pages directly; larger or background crawls return a crawlId that you can poll or cancel by calling crawl with { crawlId }.

url.description: Root public https:// URL to start crawling (omit when polling or cancelling an existing crawlId).

crawlId.description: Existing crawl ID (`crw_...`) to poll progress/results or cancel.

cancel.description: Set true with crawlId to cancel a running crawl.

async.description: Set true to run in the background immediately and return crawlId even when limit <= 5.

maxDepth.description: Maximum link hop depth from the root URL.

includePaths.description: Optional path prefixes or regexes to include.

excludePaths.description: Optional path prefixes or regexes to skip.

collectionId.description: Optional collection ID to index crawled pages into for search_collection.

offset.description: Result offset when polling an existing crawlId.

McpTool_SearchInput.title: Search Web & News (MCP search)
McpTool_SearchInput.description: Searches the web, news headlines (topic="news"), and optional indexed collections, returning ranked results with titles, URLs, snippets, and optional extracted page chunks when includeRawContent is true.

query.description: Search query (1..500 characters). Supports site:domain.com filtering (including site:<lang>.wikipedia.org or wikipedia=true for robots-compliant Wikipedia article discovery).

includeRawContent.description: When true, fetches the top result URLs and attaches ranked Markdown chunks.

chunksPerSource.description: Maximum Markdown chunks attached per result when includeRawContent is true.

mode.description: Provider strategy: "waterfall" (default) queries the primary search provider first and falls back only when results are sparse; "rrf" queries configured providers in parallel; "serper" uses only Serper.

providers.description: Optional allowlist of search providers to use.

collectionId.description: Optional indexed collection ID to merge into search results.

noCache.description: Set true to bypass cached search results and fetch fresh results.

McpTool_SearchCollectionInput.title: Search Indexed Collection (MCP search_collection)
McpTool_SearchCollectionInput.description: Searches pages previously indexed into a collection by scrape, extract, or crawl, returning BM25 relevance-scored chunks (with compact query excerpts on long passages and empty hits when no terms match).

collectionId.description: Target collection ID (e.g. "default" or a crawl ID `crw_...`).

query.description: Keyword query to match against indexed document chunks.

McpTool_InteractInput.title: Interact with Page in Sandboxed Headless Browser (MCP interact)
McpTool_InteractInput.description: Opens a page in a sandboxed headless browser and executes interactive steps (click, fill, type, press, select, scroll, wait, navigate), returning rendered Markdown, per-action URL/DOM change telemetry, warnings when clicks have no effect, optional screenshots, and a sessionId when keepSession is true.

url.description: Initial public https:// URL (omit when resuming or closing an existing sessionId).

sessionId.description: Session token returned from a prior interact call with keepSession=true.

keepSession.description: Keep the isolated browser tab open for follow-up interact calls.

closeSession.description: Close an open browser session after this call.

waitForMs.description: Milliseconds to wait for page state to settle.

waitSelector.description: Optional CSS selector to wait for before extracting output.

maxChars.description: Maximum Markdown characters to return in this call (returns totalChars, remainingChars, and nextOffset when truncated).

offset.description: Character offset into the rendered Markdown for paging large pages.

McpTool_ReadArtifactInput.title: Read Paged Crawl Artifact (MCP read_artifact)
McpTool_ReadArtifactInput.description: Reads a character slice of a stored response artifact by artifactId (either a 64-character hex SHA-256 from fetch_url/fetch_batch/scrape, or an `md:<sha256>` markdownArtifactId from scrape) using offset and limit paging.

artifactId.description: 64-character hex SHA-256 artifact ID (from fetch_url/fetch_batch/scrape) OR `md:<sha256>` (markdownArtifactId from scrape).

format.description: Optional output format ("raw" default for raw artifacts; "markdown" reads derived clean Markdown when available).

offset.description: Character offset to start reading from.

limit.description: Maximum characters to return in this page.

McpTool_JobsInput.title: Search & Verify Structured Job Postings (MCP jobs)
McpTool_JobsInput.description: Searches official company job boards (Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, Workday, Workable, Gem, Rippling, SmartRecruiters, company-domain career page discovery, and Built In) or batch-verifies saved job URLs, returning normalized compensation, workplaceType, locations, and posting status.

domains.description: Optional company domains (e.g. ["cloudflare.com", "stripe.com"]) to probe /careers and /jobs for official job-board discovery.

remote.description: When true, keep only remote-eligible roles.

locations.description: Optional location substrings to match (e.g. ["United States", "Remote", "New York"]).

strictPay.description: When true and minBase is set, exclude postings that do not list compensation.

postedWithinDays.description: Keep postings published within the last N days.

includeBuiltIn.description: Include Built In job listings (disabled automatically when company or domains is set).

includePublicFeeds.description: Opt in to public remote job feeds (We Work Remotely, Himalayas, Working Nomads).

mode.description: Execution mode ("search" default, or "verify" to batch-check whether saved job URLs are still live).

exclude.description: Optional list of roles to exclude from results.

McpTool_FindExtractorsInput.title: Search Built-In Keyless Site Adapters (MCP find_extractors)
McpTool_FindExtractorsInput.description: Searches built-in keyless site and public-data adapters (such as SEC EDGAR, arXiv, OpenAlex, ClinicalTrials, openFDA, NIST NVD CVEs, npm, PyPI, Crates, job boards, and Shopify) and returns matching adapter URL patterns and capabilities.

query.description: Provider name, domain, or data topic (e.g. "SEC 10-K", "CVE", "clinical trials").

McpTool_CatalogInput.title: Extract & Diff Full Storefront Catalog (MCP catalog)
McpTool_CatalogInput.description: Extracts normalized product, variant, pricing, SKU, and availability records from a public Shopify or WooCommerce storefront (respecting robots.txt and rate limits), or pages and filters an existing catalog snapshot by catalogId.

url.description: Public https:// storefront or collection URL (omit when paging an existing catalogId).

catalogId.description: Existing catalog run ID (`cat_...`) to poll status or page/filter product records.

platform.description: Storefront platform ("auto" detects Shopify vs WooCommerce).

fields.description: "full" includes descriptions and images; "lean" returns compact pricing, SKU, and availability fields.

maxPages.description: Maximum catalog pages to fetch sequentially.

pauseMs.description: Polite pause between sequential pages in milliseconds.

sync.description: Set false to run in the background and poll with catalogId.

offset.description: Record offset when paging an existing catalogId.

limit.description: Maximum records to return when paging an existing catalogId (default 50).

vendor.description: Optional vendor/brand filter when paging catalogId records.

productType.description: Optional productType filter when paging catalogId records.

availableOnly.description: When true, keep only products with at least one in-stock variant.

query.description: Optional keyword filter across title, handle, vendor, tags, and SKUs when paging catalogId.

site.description: Optional worker site ID when target="agent".

McpTool_AgentInput.title: Autonomous Research & Structured Data Agent (MCP agent)
McpTool_AgentInput.description: Runs a multi-step LLM-guided web research and semantic JSON-Schema extraction agent using either a configured server LLM or a caller-supplied BYO-LLM (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter, Ollama, or Workers AI), returning synthesized answers or schema-validated JSON.

prompt.description: Natural-language research question or extraction goal.

agentId.description: Existing `agt_...` run ID to poll status, fetch trace spans, or cancel.

trace.description: Return execution trace spans when polling agentId.

strictConstrainToURLs.description: Restrict navigation strictly to the provided seed urls.

schema.description: Optional JSON Schema for semantic structured output validation.

threadId.description: Optional prior `agt_...` threadId for multi-turn follow-up.

zeroDataRetention.description: When true, skips persisting run history or cached artifacts.

llm.description: Optional BYO-LLM configuration (e.g. { provider: "openai"|"anthropic"|"gemini"|"ollama", model, baseUrl, apiKey }).

McpTool_DiscoverMcpsInput.title: Discover MCP Servers (Official Registry + Glama) (MCP discover_mcps)
McpTool_DiscoverMcpsInput.description: Searches the Official Model Context Protocol Registry and Glama directory to find remote and local MCP servers, returning endpoint URLs, authentication requirements, and associated domains.

query.description: Search keyword, service name, or domain (e.g. "linear", "notion", "github", "sentry", "stripe").

remoteOnly.description: When true, return only servers offering remote HTTP or SSE endpoints.

McpTool_QueryMcpInput.title: Query Connected Federated MCP Server (MCP query_mcp)
McpTool_QueryMcpInput.description: Lists your connected downstream MCP servers, inspects their available tool schemas on demand, or invokes a tool on a connected downstream MCP server.

action.description: "list_connected" lists connected MCP servers; "list_tools" inspects tools on a server; "call_tool" executes a tool on a server.

server.description: Connected MCP server slug or domain (required for "list_tools" and "call_tool").

tool.description: Downstream MCP tool name to execute (required when action="call_tool").

arguments.description: JSON object arguments passed to the downstream MCP tool when action="call_tool".

refresh.description: When true on action="list_tools", fetches fresh tool definitions from the remote MCP server.
